public_gates: fresh 1024-step PPO smoke from M239 public-gate base
M183 M168 and M170 replay gates
forbidden_shortcuts: do not promote raw PPO without interpolation gates
do not use sampled fixed-batch objective as the primary objective gate
do not run more than one PPO smoke in M243
do not loosen replay or protected-key thresholds
hypothesis: Starting from the M239 public-gate base and using exact full-corpus objective gates should make PPO continuation decisions more reliable than the M237/M240 sampled fixed-batch workflow.
success_criteria: run exactly one 1024-step PPO smoke from M239 alpha 0.5
interpolate from M239 to the raw PPO checkpoint without additional training
select only an alpha that improves exact M232 or does not regress it while improving exact M223
selected alpha must pass full replay gates protected key and behavior retention
record whether exact-objective-gated continuation is viable
failure_criteria: raw PPO or all interpolation alphas regress exact M232 materially
no alpha passes full replay gates

commands.name: m243_train_and_gate
commands.command: Run one exact-gated PPO smoke from M239, then interpolate and gate exact M232/M223 objectives, replay, protected key, and behavior.

decision_rule: M243 may promote only an interpolation alpha that passes exact objective gates plus full proof and behavior retention. If no alpha passes, reject and audit the continuation recipe before more PPO.
next_blocker: Run one exact-gated PPO smoke from M239.
